## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (1)
- `POST /user/accessToken.json` — Obtain an access token for user authentication.

### Data Read (5)
- `GET /{id}` — Get details for a specific game by its ID.
- `GET /en/now_on_sale` — Get a list of currently on-sale games.
- `GET /en/productcard/patronage/users` — Get a list of users who support a product.
- `GET /v1/account/basic` — Retrieve basic account information for the user.
- `GET /v1/pages/2f/sections/{sectionId}` — Retrieve a specific section from a page.

### Realtime (1)
- `POST /clients/{clientId}/events` — Send client events to the GOG platform.

### Config (1)
- `GET /v1/store/configuration` — Fetch store configuration settings.
